squeak.who: an off-screen voice, nobody on screen: the "GET OUT!" that ends a skit. It is a recording Edu supplied on 17 Nov 2026 ("here it is. use this."), kept on the media branch as sfx/getout.mp3 (not on main); "file" plays it as the line. No character says it: no talk, no pointing, no mouth movement. The voice settings here are only the fallback if the file cannot be loaded. If a reel is ever muted or flagged for its audio, delete "file" from this entry in every channel.
